power.method: High PoE (Bosch 60 W / 95 W midspan) or 24 VAC

features: 12x optical zoom (12x digital) with Optical Image Stabilization
Open camera platform (OC) with apps from the Azena application store
AI-based traffic detection for traffic monitoring
Intelligent Video Analytics, also while camera is moving
360 deg continuous pan, 290 deg tilt; pan 0.2-120 deg/s, tilt 0.2-90 deg/s, presets 120 deg/s
Optional MIC-ILx-400 IR / white-light illuminator accessory
IP66 / IP68 / Type 6P, IK10 (excluding window), anodized aluminum
Power consumption 40 W typical without illuminator, 70 W with illuminator
dimensions_mm: 287.93 x 400.34 x 210.65 (W x H x D, upright)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (MIC_7604_Z12GR_OC_Data_sheet_enUS_87770923275.pdf). Gray (RAL 7001) OC (open camera / AI traffic detection) enhanced model; available in specific regions only. Order number F.01U.400.435 = North America. Sensor effective pixels 5544 x 3694. Sensitivity at 30 IRE.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
